summary: Comprehensive auth + multi-tenant regression testing for Iteration-5. 33/33 backend pytest cases pass and 8/8 frontend Playwright flows pass. Verified: (1) auth gating on all 17 endpoints returns 401 without Bearer token; (2) /api/auth/me, /api/auth/session, /api/auth/logout behave correctly; (3) multi-tenant isolation - User A and User B see only their own settings, shipments, dashboard stats and bulk-download CSV; cross-user GET shipment/track/label returns 404; new user has zero stats; (4) frontend - unauth redirects to /login, Login page renders Sign-in with Google button, cookie-based auth shows correct user in sidebar, navigation across Shipments/Settings works, logout clears session and re-redirects.
action_items: (Optional, carried from iter4) Replace native <input type=date> on SchedulePickup with shadcn Calendar/Popover for design consistency.
(Optional refactor, carried from iter4) server.py is ~1080 lines; consider splitting into routes/, services/delhivery.py, auth.py, models.py for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: get_current_user() correctly accepts BOTH cookie (session_token) and Authorization: Bearer header - good fallback for cross-origin clients where SameSite=None cookies may be blocked.
All shipment/pickup/settings queries include {user_id: current_user.user_id} filter - verified isolation at DB query level. No cross-tenant leak.
POST /api/auth/session uses email as natural key (find_one by email) - if same Google email signs in twice the existing user_id is reused, preventing duplicate accounts.
PUT /api/settings uses upsert with {user_id: current_user.user_id} - correctly creates per-user settings document.
Session token is generated by Emergent Auth provider (not us); stored as-is in user_sessions.session_token. Expiry stored as ISO string, parsed back with tz-aware comparison - correct.
Cookie set with httpOnly=True, secure=True, samesite=none, max_age=7d - correct for cross-origin SPA. Frontend uses withCredentials=true.

Pydantic User model declares created_at as datetime but DB stores ISO string; Pydantic v2 coerces ISO string -> datetime so GET /api/auth/me works (verified). Could be made explicit with field_validator for robustness.
/api/shipments/{id}, /track, /label all use combined query {id: shipment_id, user_id: current_user.user_id} so other-user IDs correctly return 404 (no info leak via 403 vs 404 distinction).

success_rate.backend: 100% (33/33 pytest cases: 6 auth, 18 auth-gating, 1 settings isolation, 8 shipment/stats/bulk isolation)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (8/8: unauth->/login redirect, login page render, Google button, cookie-auth->layout, sidebar user name+email, nav to Shipments, nav to Settings, logout->login, post-logout redirect)

test_credentials: Test sessions created directly in MongoDB via test fixtures (TEST_ prefix). Auto-cleanup after suite. See /app/memory/test_credentials.md for mongosh recipe. Delhivery API key shared and unchanged.
seed_data_creation: All test data prefixed TEST_; cleanup verified - 0 TEST_ users/sessions/settings/shipments remain in test_database after run.
verified_endpoints: GET /api/auth/me - 401 no auth, 401 invalid bearer, 200 valid bearer (returns user_id+email+name)
POST /api/auth/logout - 200 + deletes session row + token becomes invalid afterwards
PUT /api/settings - 401 without auth; with auth, stores per-user settings
Multi-tenant: User A settings (business_name='Biz A', seller_gst='GSTINA001') and User B settings (business_name='Biz B', seller_gst='GSTINB002') stored independently and never cross-leak
Multi-tenant: User A's shipment id visible only to A; B's GET /api/shipments/{A_id} -> 404; same for /track and /label
GET /api/dashboard/stats for a brand-new user = 0 across all counters even when other users have shipments
GET /api/shipments/bulk/download CSV contains only current user's order_ids
verified_frontend_flows: Unauthenticated GET / -> redirected to /login; login-page testid present with Sign in with Google button.
After setting session_token cookie with valid token, GET / renders Layout - app-title, user-section, user-name='Frontend Tester', user-email='TEST_fe@example.com' all visible in sidebar.
Sidebar navigation: clicked nav-shipments -> URL changed to /shipments; clicked nav-settings -> URL changed to /settings.
Clicked logout-btn -> POST /api/auth/logout -> redirected to /login -> session token invalidated server-side.
After logout, GET / again -> redirected to /login (no stale auth).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth tests in /app/backend/tests/test_auth_multitenant.py use direct mongo insert to create sessions (bypasses Emergent Auth provider) with TEST_ prefix and auto-cleanup. Run with: export $(grep -v '^#' frontend/.env|xargs) && export MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=test_database && pytest backend/tests/test_auth_multitenant.py -v. Multi-tenant tests insert shipments directly in DB to avoid live Delhivery calls (track/label still hit Delhivery only if shipment belongs to user - 404 short-circuits before that). Iter4 tests (test_iteration4_features.py) still pass and use real Delhivery API; just need to wrap requests with Authorization: Bearer <test-token> created via mongosh recipe.
